1532701.name: Thin Thorn
1532701.description:
Fires thin thorns, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The thin thorns can be intercepted.

1532702.name: Wing Scales
1532702.description:
Fires wing scales, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The wing scales can be intercepted.

1532703.name: Thick Thorn
1532703.description: Fires thick thorns, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.

1532704.name: Sparkle Beam
1532704.description:
Fires a charged burst of energy, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Destroy all of the round eyes to interrupt the attack.

1532705.name: Dazzling Beam
1532705.description: Shoots laser beams, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1532707.name: Awesome Shield
1532707.description:
Discharges waves of energy, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Ziz generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Awesome Shield. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1532709.name: Strongest Deathblow
1532709.description: Fires countless concentrated energy bombs, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1532715.name: Freeze Beam
1532715.description: Restrains Nikkes, dealing damage after a certain period of time.
